paperInfo.subject: Statistics
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from ZIMSEC syllabus/specimen structure and recurring exam themes; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC syllabus/specimen resources and publicly accessible examination-pattern references.

questions.questionText: Sampling and data presentation: A study records a quantitative variable with sample mean 21 and standard deviation 4. (a) State a suitable statistic for summarising the centre. (b) Explain how the standard deviation describes variation. (c) Describe one condition that should be considered before drawing an inference from the sample.
questions.explanation: The mean is a measure of central tendency; standard deviation measures spread around the mean; inference requires appropriate sampling, model assumptions and context.
